description: Defines the HealthResult record used to represent the outcome of health checks in the backend API, including static methods for creating 'up' and 'down' status results.

classes.name: HealthResult
classes.description: A record representing the health check result with a boolean isUp and a details map.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Creates a HealthResult indicating the service is up, with optional details.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Creates a HealthResult indicating the service is down, with optional details.
